title: Refactor extreme cognitive complexity — ChatToolCatalog (177), harness.py (138), MemoryChatAgent.ToolLoop (73), MemoryApplicationService (67)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
4 methods with extreme cognitive complexity scores (limit is 15):
1. `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatToolCatalog.cs` (L138) — score 177
2. `MemorySmith.Training/harness.py` (L376) — score 138
3. `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemoryChatAgent.ToolLoop.cs` (L66) — score 73
4. `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemoryApplicationService.cs` (L245) — score 67

## Impact
These methods are extremely difficult to understand, test, and maintain. They represent the highest-priority refactoring targets in the codebase.

## Action Required
Decompose each method into smaller focused methods:
- **ChatToolCatalog.cs (177):** Split by tool category registration logic; extract each tool's metadata registration into separate methods
- **harness.py (138):** Break training loop phases (setup, per-epoch logic, evaluation, teardown) into separate functions/classes
- **MemoryChatAgent.ToolLoop.cs (73):** Extract individual tool handlers into separate methods; extract state machine transitions
- **MemoryApplicationService.cs (67):** Split by retrieval strategy (lexical, semantic, hybrid, etc.) into separate sub-methods

## Effort
~2h

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
